name: DocuSeal
description: DocuSeal lets you create document templates, send them for signing, and track submission status — all through Claude. Search your existing templates by name, upload new PDFs to create signable forms with auto-detected fields, send documents to multiple signers via email, and search signed or pending submissions by submitter name, email, or template. Built for teams that need fast, simple e-signatures without leaving their workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocuSeal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocuSeal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://docuseal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocuSeal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocuSeal provides these MCP tools: search_templates, create_template, send_documents, and search_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocuSeal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocuSeal in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DocuSeal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DocuSeal is developed by DocuSeal. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
